origin.description: List the packages available in one or more repositories, and cache that matrix.

arguments.name: repos
arguments.text: Character vector, the base URL(s) of the repositories to use. Names are part of the cache key. getOption("repos") may be "@CRAN@", which asks for a mirror.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Character string giving the package type. "source" reads repo/src/contrib. "both" uses the source repository.

origin.details: The result is utils::available.packages(utils::contrib.url(repos, type), type = type), with warnings suppressed, then stored by available_packages_set. A later call with the same repos and type returns that matrix and does not download again. For type "source" the index is the PACKAGES file. The columns are the standard repository fields, File, and Repository. This file has no File field, so that column is missing. A Path value is appended to the contrib URL and is not itself a column. The default filters are R_version, OS_type, and subarch. Duplicate package names keep the first repository when the versions are equal.
origin.value: A character matrix with one row per package. Row names are the package names.
origin.example:
available_packages_reset()
db <- available_packages("https://cloud.r-project.org", "source")
cat(paste0("available_packages(\"https://cloud.r-project.org\", \"source\") lists remotes at version ", db["remotes", "Version"], ".\n"))

translation.description: List the packages available in one or more repositories, and cache that matrix.

arguments.name: repos
arguments.text: A string, a list of strings, or a dict of names to base URLs. A string or a list is an unnamed character vector. A dict is a named vector, and its keys are part of the cache key. "@CRAN@" is an error. Pass the repository URL; getOption("repos") may be "@CRAN@".

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: "source" reads repo/src/contrib/PACKAGES. "both" uses that same source URL and is cached under "both". The check uses "source".

translation.details: The contrib URL is the repository with one trailing slash removed, then /src/contrib. PACKAGES is read with urllib and parsed as DCF. The columns match utils::available.packages. File is missing because the index has no File field. Path is appended to the contrib URL and stored as Repository. Filters run in order: an R(...) constraint in Depends is tested against the installed R version, OS_type keeps a missing value or this platform, and an empty r_arch keeps every row. Duplicate package names keep the newest version, and the first repository when the versions are equal. The matrix is passed to available_packages_set. A later call returns the cached matrix and does not download.
translation.value: An AvailablePackages matrix. Columns are lists, missing cells are None, and rownames are the package names.
translation.example:
from remotes.available_packages import available_packages, available_packages_reset
available_packages_reset()
db = available_packages("https://cloud.r-project.org", "source")
version = db["Version"][db.rownames.index("remotes")]
print("available_packages(\"https://cloud.r-project.org\", \"source\") lists remotes at version " + version + ".")
